scorer_contract: Class Dice, clDice, B0, HD95, invalid-neighbor error against v1 valid-neighbor JSON, side-road F1 and mean leaderboard position; prediction is nearest-neighbor SimpleITK-resampled to GT reference when shape differs. Do not infer affine validation or clinical validity from score. The grader overwrites prediction metadata with GT metadata even for equal shapes. Per-case foreground metrics average labels present in either GT or prediction; case means then average. Side-road F1 aggregates detections.

production_draft.basis: native source image and source annotations plus symbolic empty output schema; no participant output or score
production_draft.top_warning: Exact one-case source teaching view. No participant output or score.

root_contract_audit.geometry: Shape mismatch triggers SimpleITK nearest-neighbor resampling to the GT physical reference. compute_all_metrics_for_case then unconditionally copies GT information onto prediction, including same-shape predictions. This is not independent affine validation.
root_contract_audit.aggregation: For each case, Dice/clDice/B0/HD95/invalid-neighbor metrics average the union of foreground label IDs present in GT or prediction; per-case means are averaged. Side-road F1 aggregates detection counts across cases. No grader run or score is retained.
root_contract_audit.submission: The preparer sample includes image_id,modality,predicted_mask_path; the grader explicitly requires only image_id and predicted_mask_path and does not validate modality.
root_contract_audit.receipt_cleanup: Removed an inherited nested TopCoW label geometry field; the separate exact TopBrain v1 label geometry is authoritative and unchanged.
